name: Silver Wolf LV.999
description:
A new season of Elation begins, featuring the limited-time return of the invincible player "Silver Wolf LV.999"!
She's conquered the universe, unlocked every cosmic achievement... What's left to play?
"Reach the peak of 'Elation'? Boring... Since I've got the cartridge now, I make the rules~"

skills.name: One Punch!
skills.desc: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf LV.999's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Trigger Happy
skills.desc: Gains #2[i] Punchline point(s) and deals Imaginary DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf LV.999's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDesc: Gains Punchline. Deals Imaginary DMG to all enemies.

extra.name: Punchline
extra.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

skills.name: God Mode: ON!
skills.desc:
Enters the "Godmode Player" state, and advances action by 100%.
Deploys a Zone while in the "Godmode Player" state. While Silver Wolf LV.999 holds "Certified Banger," for every 1 Skill Point consumed by an ally target within the Zone, there is a chance to trigger 1 instance of Silver Wolf LV.999's "Top Loot Box": Deals #3[i]% Imaginary Elation DMG that is distributed evenly among all enemies, and randomly triggers 1 of the following effects:
"Big Flipping Sword": Additionally deals True DMG equal to #5[i]% of the total DMG dealt this time to the enemy target with the highest HP.
"Kaboom Eggsplosion": Recovers #7[i] Skill Point(s).
"Funky Munch Bean": Gains #6[i] Punchline point(s).
The initial fixed chance to trigger the effect is 100%. After a successfully trigger, the fixed chance for the next trigger is reduced to #4[i]% of the current chance. If the target is defeated before it triggers, it will instead trigger on a newly entering enemy target.
skills.simpleDesc:
Transforms and advances action by 100%.
Deploys a Zone during Transformation. While holding "Certified Banger," for every 1 Skill Point consumed by allies, there is a high chance to trigger 1 "Top Loot Box": Deals massive Imaginary Elation DMG that is distributed evenly among all enemies, and randomly triggers 1 of the following effects:
Deals True DMG to the target with the highest HP based on total DMG dealt.
Recovers Skill Points.
Gains Punchline.
The trigger chance decreases proportionally after each trigger.

extra.name: Action Advance
extra.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

extra.name: Certified Banger
extra.desc:
Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.
Punchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.
The duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

extra.name: Fixed Chance
extra.desc: Fixed chance will not be affected by any factor.

extra.name: Top Loot Box
extra.desc:
Special Attack that ally targets can trigger while in Silver Wolf LV.<nobr>999</nobr>'s Zone when Silver Wolf LV.<nobr>999</nobr> has "Certified Banger." Can also be actively triggered in "Bonus Stage: αWolf Instant." Triggering via this method is not considered as launching 1 attack.
When used, deals massive Imaginary Elation DMG split evenly among all enemies and randomly triggers one of the following 3 effects:
"Big Flipping Sword": Deals True DMG to the target with the highest HP based on the total DMG dealt this time.
"Kaboom Eggsplosion": Restores Skill Points (Trigger rate increases when Skill Points are low. Trigger rate decreases when Skill Points are high).
"Funky Munch Bean": Gains Punchline (Trigger rate increases when "Hidden MMR" is low. Trigger rate decreases when "Hidden MMR" is high).

extra.name: Elation DMG
extra.desc:
The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.
Elation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

extra.name: True DMG
extra.desc: Non-Type DMG that is not affected by any effects. This DMG is not considered as launching 1 attack.

extra.name: Punchline
extra.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

skills.name: I Carry, We Win
skills.desc:
After "Hidden MMR" reaches #1[i], can activate Ultimate. And after reaching its maximum limit, it can overflow by an additional #2[i] point(s).
When gaining Punchline, Silver Wolf LV.999 gains an equal amount of "Hidden MMR." Each point of "Hidden MMR" increases CRIT Rate by #4[f2]%. Once CRIT Rate reaches 100%, each additional point of "Hidden MMR" instead increases CRIT DMG by #6[f2]%.
While in the "Godmode Player" state, Silver Wolf LV.999 becomes immune to Crowd Control debuffs, cannot use Ultimate, and gains Enhanced Basic ATK and Enhanced Elation Skill. After fully using Enhanced Basic ATK #5[i] time(s), she exits the "Godmode Player" state. When exiting the "Godmode Player" state, clears "Hidden MMR".
While holding "Certified Banger," using Basic ATK or Skill deals #3[i]% Imaginary Elation DMG to the attacked enemy targets. And the Enhanced Basic ATK's ability DMG changes to Elation DMG at the same multiplier.
skills.simpleDesc:
After "Hidden MMR" reaches #1[i], the Ultimate can be activated. When gaining Punchline, gains an equal amount of "Hidden MMR". The higher the "Hidden MMR", the higher the CRIT Rate. Once CRIT Rate reaches 100%, increases CRIT DMG instead.
During Transformation, Silver Wolf LV.999 becomes immune to Crowd Control debuffs, and her Basic ATK and Elation Skill get enhanced. She exits the Transformation after using Enhanced Basic ATK #5[i] time(s).
While holding "Certified Banger," using Basic ATK or Skill additionally deals Imaginary Elation DMG. And the Enhanced Basic ATK's ability DMG changes to Elation DMG.

extra.name: Punchline
extra.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

extra.name: Crowd Control debuff
extra.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

extra.name: Certified Banger
extra.desc:

Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.
Punchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.
The duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

extra.name: Elation DMG
extra.desc:
The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.
Elation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

skills.name: This? Absolute Meta!
skills.desc:
Summons "Funky Munch Bean." Use again to dismiss. Using Technique does not consume Technique Points. When Technique Points reach 0, the summon is dismissed and Technique cannot be used.
"Funky Munch Bean" causes Normal Enemies within a certain range to enter a Terrified state. It will also automatically search for and attack Normal Enemies, consuming 1 Technique Point to instantly defeat them without entering combat.
While "Funky Munch Bean" is present, after entering combat, 1 instance of "Top Loot Box" from "Funky Munch Bean" is triggered at the start of each wave. A fixed amount of #1[i] "Certified Banger" is taken into account for the Elation DMG dealt in this instance.
skills.simpleDesc:
Summons "Funky Munch Bean." Use again to dismiss. Using Technique does not consume Technique Points.
"Funky Munch Bean" will automatically seek out and attack Normal Enemies, consuming 1 Technique Point to instantly defeat them without entering combat.
After entering combat, triggers the Top Loot Box corresponding to "Funky Munch Bean" at the start of each wave.

"Funky Munch Bean": Gains Punchline (Trigger rate increases when "Hidden MMR" is low. Trigger rate decreases when "Hidden MMR" is high).

eidolons.name: Aether Editing: Eidolon +1
eidolons.desc:
Enemy targets in the Zone take <nobr>20%</nobr> increased DMG.
When exiting the "Godmode Player" state, "Hidden MMR" will not be cleared. Instead, <nobr>20%</nobr> of "Hidden MMR" will be retained.

eidolons.name: It's a Feature, Not a Bug
eidolons.desc: After entering the "Godmode Player" state, extends the duration of all <u>buffs</u> on this unit by 1 turn. In the current "Godmode Player" state, for every <nobr>120</nobr> point(s) of "Hidden MMR" increased (including the initial "Hidden MMR"), Silver Wolf LV.<nobr>999</nobr> gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> and regains 1 use of Enhanced Basic ATK.

extra.name: Buff
extra.desc: All status effects that provide beneficial combat buffs, can be dispelled unless stated otherwise.

extra.name: Extra Turn
extra.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

eidolons.name: Max Lv. 15? Says who?
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>10</nobr>.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.

eidolons.name: I Came. I Saw. I One-Shot.
eidolons.desc: <u>Elation DMG</u> dealt by "Honkai-DMG Demo" additionally takes into account <u>Punchline</u>, equal to the original amount multiplied by <nobr>5</nobr>.

extra.name: Elation DMG
extra.desc:
The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.
Elation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

extra.name: Punchline
extra.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

eidolons.name: Basic ATK Is the New Ultimate
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.

eidolons.name: Solo Maxxing!
eidolons.desc:
<u>Elation DMG</u> dealt during Enhanced Basic ATK <u>merrymakes</u> by <nobr>50%</nobr>.
When enemy targets enter combat, they are implanted with "Absolute Weakness": Has All-Type Weakness, and reduces their All-Type <u>Base RES</u> to 0. (If <u>Base RES</u> is already at 0, then the corresponding Type RES decreases by <nobr>20%</nobr> instead).

extra.name: Elation DMG
extra.desc:
The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.
Elation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

extra.name: Merrymake
extra.desc: A special effect that affects Elation DMG and can additionally boost Elation DMG dealt.

extra.name: Base RES
extra.desc: The fixed DMG Type RES a target has when entering combat. Under normal circumstances, it cannot be modified.

embedBonusSkill.name: False Ending Speedrun
embedBonusSkill.desc: When SPD is <nobr>160</nobr> or higher, increases this unit's Elation by <nobr>50%</nobr>. For every <nobr>1</nobr> SPD exceeded, increases this unit's Elation by <nobr>2%</nobr>. Up to a max of <nobr>100</nobr> excess SPD can be taken into account for this effect.

embedBonusSkill.name: True Ending Unlocked
embedBonusSkill.desc: If the number of <u>Punchline</u> points taken into account when using Elation Skill is <nobr>20</nobr> or more, additionally gains <nobr>20</nobr> "Hidden MMR" points (And if it's <nobr>40</nobr> or more, then gains <nobr>20</nobr> more points on top of that).

embedBonusSkill.name: Secret Level Maxed
embedBonusSkill.desc: After entering the "Godmode Player" state, gains <nobr>20</nobr> "Hidden MMR" point(s).
